title: A large software renewal increase and the cost of switching
discussion_signal: The post describes a 68% renewal increase, a costly migration, and a later retention offer after the customer had switched. It treats switching costs as a source of leverage, but also shows that a sufficiently large price shock can make exit worthwhile.
linked_research_question: When switching is costly, how do pricing power, customer dependence, retention tactics, and actual exit shape usable competition.
limits: Single business account and selected professional audience
Price and migration details are not independently verified
One successful switch is not evidence of market-wide competition
